postReview.title: Superliga femenina: el Manchester City se pone líder y London City Lionesses supera al Tottenham
postReview.description: El Manchester City se colocó por encima del Chelsea en lo alto de la Superliga femenina gracias a su 2-1 ante el Everton el domingo.

postReview.title: Women's Super League: Man City move top as Lionesses overcome Spurs
postReview.description: Manchester City moved ahead of Chelsea at the summit of the Women's Super League thanks to a 2-1 win over Everton on Sunday.

postReview.title: Superliga inglesa feminina: Manchester City assume a liderança; London City Lionesses bate o Spurs
postReview.description: O Manchester City assumiu a liderança da Superliga inglesa feminina ao vencer o Everton por 2 a 1 neste domingo.

postReview.title: Women's Super League: il Man City va in testa, il London City Lionesses supera il Tottenham
postReview.description: Il Manchester City ha scavalcato il Chelsea in vetta alla Women's Super League grazie al 2-1 sull'Everton di domenica.

postReview.title: Women's Super League : Manchester City prend la tête, les Lionesses viennent à bout de Tottenham
postReview.description: Manchester City est passé devant Chelsea en tête de la Women's Super League grâce à sa victoire 2-1 à Everton dimanche.

postReview.title: Women's Super League: Man City übernimmt die Spitze, Lionesses bezwingen Spurs
postReview.description: Manchester City übernahm dank eines 2:1-Siegs am Sonntag bei Everton die Spitze der Women's Super League vor Chelsea.

postReview.title: Liga Feminina inglesa: Man City sobe à liderança e London City Lionesses supera o Tottenham
